title: gaspatchio_column_transformation facet
description: How each of a node's reads was narrowed, carried on the node that did the reading (sections 6 and 9 of the specification) and announced in facets_used, never in facets_required. The definition is the artifact schema's own, referenced rather than restated here, so the facet a validator holds an artifact to and the facet this document describes cannot part company.
